hints.title: Subproblem Partition Boundary
hints.text: Consider the optimal partition of the prefix ending at index i. The final contiguous chunk ending at index i can have any length j between 1 and k.

hints.title: Running Chunk Maximum
hints.text: As j increases from 1 to min(k, i), maintain the maximum element in that final chunk. The contribution of this chunk is chunk max multiplied by j.

hints.title: DP Tabulation
hints.text: Set dp[i] = max over all j of (dp[i - j] + cur_max * j). Base case is dp[0] = 0. The final answer is dp[n].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all valid partitions with recursion without memoization takes exponential O(K^N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 1D dynamic programming with an inner window of length K solves the problem in O(N * K) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should define dp[i] as optimal answer for prefix i and iterate over the last chunk size j.
complexity.notes: Space can be reduced to O(K) by keeping only the last K + 1 DP states.
